data.summary: Schornsteintechnik Beispielruß GmbH billed Bastian Musterquell €1,785.60 for chimney renovation work (new stainless steel flue pipe, connector/cleaning door, and the district chimney sweep's acceptance inspection) carried out on 16–17 November 2026 at Quellenweg 7. Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date (19 November 2026) without deduction.
data.explanation: This is a craftsman's invoice for chimney repair work done at your home. You need to pay the full amount of €1,785.60 to the company's IBAN by the deadline shown (the app calculates it from the 14-day period stated in the invoice, counted from the invoice date). If you don't pay on time, the company could send reminders or charge late-payment interest, though none is stated here. Keep this invoice: craftsman labour costs (Handwerkerleistungen) for work on your home can often be partly deducted on your German tax return, so it may be worth mentioning to a tax advisor or including when you file.
